comments.body: The issue is that there is a privacy policy in place and there are people content on using my email address, my browsers, my applications and they are recovering passwords with tokens, cookies, special links and flash player storage.  I just recovered an app for Google cloud where Iam fully signed in and the project on it is not mine.  But its my app, probably my debit  card on file, and I bet it has more of my data stored in it.  Clearly a direct violation of the privacy policy.   Oh but we're taking about Firefox, 2 partitions, 1 user, 1 guest only one side has the ability to switch and when the switch is done the other user is logged out.  When I found those add on, they put the settings on my side, I didn't know what it was until the sync was disabled. Now that I know what to look for and with whom.  Iam going to KILL every trace of my old Data once and for all.

comments.body: @arroyoshipp Your response above doesn't really give us any idea of exactly what the problem is, but it does seem to not have anything to do with the addons.mozilla.org (AMO) website. I am therefore going to close this issue. Feel free to re-open it if you have a specific problem to report about AMO.
